text:
1 of this Part of this Schedule) structurally derived from 17-hydroxyandrostan-3-one or from 17-
hydroxyestran-3-one by modification in any of the following ways, that is to say -
(a) by further substitution at position 17 by a methyl or ethyl group;
(b) by substitution to any extent at one or more of positions 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11 or 16, but at
no other position;
(c) by unsaturation in the carbocyclic ring system to any extent, provided that there are no
more than two ethylenic bonds in any one carbocyclic ring;
(d) by fusion of ring A with a heterocyclic system.

3. Any substance which is an ester or ether (or, where more than one hydroxyl function is
available, both an ester and an ether) of a substance specified in paragraph 1 or described in paragraph

2 of this Part of this Schedule.
